label: B25-GATE-D
title: Run detached Gate D on the frozen B25 source candidate
scope: Run the repository Gate D suite against the frozen B25 source candidate in an isolated worktree, preserving all normal assertions and difftest comparisons; this is local functional regression only and does not replace T-042 physical or board validation.
writes: build/agents/T-20260907-046/** ignored logs and runtime artifacts
validation: Confirm worktree source files match 259188ac and record QEMU/plugin/tool hashes before launch.
Run make test and bash sim/difftest/run_gate_d.sh --parallel using existing unmodified gate definitions.
Record every group result, first failure if any, actual elapsed/RSS/resources and artifact hashes.
Do not convert missing tools/images, timeout, skipped comparison or assertion suppression into PASS.
acceptance: The exact B25 source candidate completes all current Gate D groups with no disabled assertion/reference check; otherwise preserve the first failure and report blocked/failed without changing RTL.

resource.policy: Acquire local through resource-lock for the entire heavy run; task-local TMPDIR/build roots; choose bounded parallelism from current machine resources and keep user interactivity responsive. Return 75 means wait.

forbidden_regions: another worktree or shared writable QEMU build
